Savannah area, GA (Richmond Hill, Port Wentworth)
profile.org_note: One Atlanta office (2700 Cumberland Pkwy SE, Suite 130), about 51 employees, functional not divisional: no regional or division presidents. Founder Jim Chapman is CEO and chairman; Chris Mancuso became president in February 2026 and runs operations. Land is handled by Jackson Jones (general counsel and VP of Land Acquisition), Brandon Woods (Assistant VP of Land Acquisition, hired September 2026), Kevin Hess (VP, Land Development) and AJ Colasurdo (Director of Preconstruction, Land Development); finance by CFO Don Brown.
profile.summary: Not a conventional for-sale homebuilder: JCCG is a private, founder-owned build-to-rent (BTR) general contractor and lot developer in Atlanta that builds rental cottage, townhome and single-family communities for institutional investors, REITs and private developers, who own the finished communities. Its Builder 100 rank (No. 79) rests on 708 homes completed in 2025, plus 1,040 lots delivered, across GA, AL, FL and IN; it projects 1,150 completions in 2026 and 1,450 in 2027. It is the successor to Jim Chapman Communities, the founder's metro-Atlanta active-adult (55+) for-sale brand, and moved wholly to BTR in 2018. As a land-banking customer it is an edge case: it does source, entitle and develop land (it has a land acquisition team and lists 'you have land to sell' on its contact form), but the lots end up with rental owners rather than being taken down for sale, so any fit would be finished-lot or development funding for BTR projects, usually alongside the capital partner that owns the project.

people.name: Jackson Jones
people.title: Corporate Legal Counsel, Vice President of Land Acquisition
people.prior_role: Residential closing attorney; licensed attorney since 1991 (real estate law)
people.note: Dual role: general counsel (drafts the GC agreements) and VP of Land Acquisition. Bio says he managed the acquisition and closing of five cottage-style communities (over 1,000 units) and is involved in five more sites across the Southeast. Company page spells the title 'Corporate Legal Council'. Reporting line not stated.

people.name: Brandon Woods
people.title: Assistant Vice President of Land Acquisition
people.prior_role: ResiBuilt and ResiCap (build-to-rent development); about 20 years in real estate development
people.source_title: JCCG Names Brandon Woods Assistant VP of Land Acquisition (company news)
people.note: New hire, September 2026: leads land acquisition and site assessment for the pipeline, working with landowners, brokers and developers. A first version of the release dated 2026-09-09 gave the title as 'Associate Vice President'; the re-issued 2026-09-11 version says 'Assistant Vice President' (kept here as the newer one). Announced by president Chris Mancuso; reporting line not stated. Not yet shown on the company team page.

people.name: Kevin Hess
people.title: Vice President, Land Development
people.note: Runs horizontal development: engineers and consultants, plan refinement, municipal permitting. A May 2024 company release describes him as a 25-year JCCG veteran whom AJ Colasurdo works closely with. Reporting line not stated.

people.name: AJ Colasurdo
people.title: Director of Preconstruction, Land Development
people.prior_role: Landscape architect at a civil engineering firm (14 years)
people.note: Bio says his scope includes land acquisition and due diligence (site selection, zoning, geotech, utilities), negotiating land purchase agreements with the legal and finance teams, and pre-construction planning, budgeting and permitting. Joined per company news post dated 2024-05-29. Reporting line not stated. The 2024 hiring release says he 'works closely with' Kevin Hess, VP of Land Development, who is quoted announcing him; reporting to Hess is inferred from that.

people.name: Don Brown
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.note: Responsible for financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and audit, and for business and financial strategy with senior management. The only finance executive the company names. Reporting line not stated.

people.name: Jim Chapman
people.title: Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board
people.prior_role: President of JCCG until February 2026; founded Jim Chapman Fine Homes (1998) and Jim Chapman Communities (2005, active adult)
people.note: Founder and owner-operator. Gave up the president title to Chris Mancuso in February 2026 and keeps long-term strategy and key client (investor/developer) relationships. Elected 2026 Third Vice Chairman of NAHB per the company news archive. Also chairman of the board of the Chapco Design Build division.

people.name: Chris Mancuso
people.title: President
people.prior_role: Vice President of JCCG (2023 to 2026); joined 2020 as Production Manager
people.source_title: Jim Chapman Construction Group Announces Chris Mancuso as President (company news)
people.note: Runs day-to-day operations, expansion and the build-to-rent contracting pipeline. Reporting to Chapman is inferred from titles (president under the CEO and chairman); the release does not state it.

people.note: Leads the new Production division and field operations across all communities. Reporting line inferred (president oversees day-to-day operations); not stated. Not yet shown on the company team page.

people.name: Kevin King
people.title: Vice President, Construction
